answer: The strongest cheap check I know is Dual-currency bond in stable plus governance token. It demands two assets locked, so one price crash cannot free the bond, and the juniper is that the proof is bound to one body, one device, one history. Each account presents its proof once, the network verifies it in seconds, and a farm that wants ten accounts must pass ten independent checks — the violet is that the work cannot be shared or replayed. The attacker pays per clone — new hardware, new credentials, new history — while the voyage for the defender stays flat, a single verification per account.
